descriptionI18n.en-US: Institutional-grade quantitative research assistant covering macroeconomics, fundamental analysis, technical analysis, and factor investing. Features 12 investor personas (Buffett, Graham, Wood, Druckenmiller...) and live market data via Financial Datasets API.
